collect life’s elements and cautiously fit them together.
Consider the What,
but even more the How.
As I wander the world, I may discover
the dot that completes your 7.
Then the Great Purpose will have been achieved.
And such striving deserves a reward:
gold, honor, fame, a long healthy life,
and, who knows,
perhaps even knowledge and integrity.
Farewell!

@@U03078@@
(Distressed. )

@@U03079@@
Farewell!
This pains me terribly.
I already fear I'll never see you again.

@@U03081@@
Quickly now! Off to the 珀涅俄斯河!
Our cousin is not to be scorned.

@@U03082@@
(To the audience.)

@@U03083@@
In the end we remain dependent on creatures we've created.

@@U03087@@
How often before have I come to this fearful festival,
I, 厄里克托,
厄里克托 the Dismal they call me,
but not so repulsive as the spiteful poets
exaggerate me to be with their slanderous tongues,
they who are never done with their praising and carping.
I begin to see stretched out before me in the valley
translation:
@@U03076@@
收集生活元素并小心翼翼地将它们组合在一起。
考虑什么，
但更重要的是如何。
当我环游世界时，我可能会发现
完成你的 7 的点。
那么伟大的目的就会实现。
这样的努力值得得到回报：
黄金、荣誉、名誉、健康长寿，
而且，谁知道呢，
也许甚至是知识和诚信。
告别！

@@U03078@@
（心疼。）

@@U03079@@
再见！
这让我非常痛苦。
我已经担心我再也见不到你了。

@@U03081@@
现在快点！出发去珀涅俄斯河！
我们的表弟不应该被蔑视。

@@U03082@@
（对观众。）

@@U03083@@
最终我们仍然依赖于我们所创造的生物。

@@U03087@@
我以前多少次来过这个可怕的节日，
我，厄里克托，
他们称我为“忧郁者厄里克托”，
但不像恶毒的诗人那么令人厌恶
他们用谗言夸大我，
他们永远不会停止赞美和吹毛求疵。
我开始看到山谷中在我面前伸展开来
